name: Clinic Scheduler
technology: Node HTTP server, no server-rendered markup; every screen built by client JavaScript; History API routing; JSON API

design.engine: QA NXT form and page test engine (deterministic)

failures.name: Clinic Scheduler: accepts a submission with only the required fields
failures.message: Expected the submission to be accepted, but the form is still shown; no field is marked invalid; messages: "Those details were not recognised."; no confirmation is shown; the route did not change from /; the page did not redraw in answer to it.

failures.name: Clinic Scheduler: tells the user when the network is down
failures.message: Expected the submission to be refused with a reason, but nothing told the user what was wrong: the form is still shown; no field is marked invalid; no error message is shown; no confirmation is shown.

failures.name: Clinic Scheduler: is usable again after a submission and going back
